name: Plumbing (Modern)
tagline: A bright, modern template for on-demand plumbers — book online from day one.
description: A modern, on-demand plumbing site — a crisp near-white palette with a vivid teal primary and warm amber accent, type-led with a "how it works" flow. Installs a working booking spine: flat-rate visits (same-day repair, drain clearing, water-heater swap, leak detection, emergency callout), three technicians dispatched by skill with their own weekly hours, and a same-day priority policy. Ships as "Rivet Plumbing Co.".
